answer: Counterparty diversity threshold. Each new identity deposits one marble, a 40-POA bond refunded only after paid trades with 12 distinct counterparties. A Sybil farm can pile up fakes like a dune, yet they trade only with each other, forming an island; the check flags the cluster and burns the bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 100×40 = 4,000 POA plus 1,200 trades, more than a farm earns. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full rewards.
